description: Companion sensor to StreamingConsumerComponent. Polls every N seconds; if no run of `job_name` is currently RUNNING/STARTING/QUEUED, fires a new RunRequest. Gives 24/7 uptime from a chain of bounded runs — the consumer exits cleanly, the sensor restarts. Restart gap is bounded by minimum_interval_seconds.

outputs.description: One RunRequest whenever no active run of job_name exists.

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Job to watch + restart. For asset-based deployments this is typically `__ASSET_JOB`.

asset_selection.label: Asset Selection
asset_selection.description: Optional list of asset keys — narrow the launched run to just the streaming asset(s).

name: Streaming Run Health Sensor
